senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; v. צָנַן) polished buckler or cuirass (cmp. סַנְוַורְתָּא).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:20">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>מנין … ת״ל וכ׳</he> whence do we learn to include the fourth side (as protected)? We read (<cite ref="Psalms 5:13">Ps. V, 13</cite>) ‘as with a cuirass &c.’ <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 35:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXV, 2</cite> <he>וכי למגן וצ׳ וכ׳</he> (ed. Bub.) do I need buckler and cuirass?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 722">Yalk. ib. 722</cite>. Tanḥ. Naso, ed. Bub. 27 (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 91:4">Ps. XCI, 4</cite>) <he>צ׳ אני נעשה לכל מי שהוא סוחר בתורה</he> I am a cuirass to whosoever travels about with the Law; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 842:4">Yalk. Ps. 842</cite>; Tanḥ. Naso 23.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 40:4">Ex. R. s. 40</cite> (ref. to <he>צנן</he>, <cite ref="Joshua 15:37">Josh. XV, 37</cite>) [read:] <he>צנן שהוא צ׳</he> Jerusalem is surnamed Zenan, because it is a cuirass (the Temple being a protection); a. e.
